card: Name: Zacuda Frolex / Mutant Zacuda Frolex — an insect-like lifeform represented here as two sequential bodies: the final surviving individual of its species, and the mutated egg offspring it laid at the moment of death
ALIAS: last of its kind — the original Zacuda Frolex was the sole surviving individual of its species when it drifted into Terra 2014
ALIAS: enormous mutant Zacuda Frolex — the egg offspring, grown to enormous size compared to the original, due to machine electrical shocks during incubation inside Police Central

ROLE: non-sentient biological catalyst; the original entered Terra 2014 via a ventilation hatch, reached Police Central, and died in a minor computer keyboard — inadvertently initiating the chain of events that sent cyber-cops to assault the Metabunker

ROLE: the mutant offspring was the direct triggering agent — it navigated the facility interior and crashed itself into control banks, reactivating an attack program and bringing three proto-nuclear units online
TRAIT: the original was small and visually indistinct; capable of autonomous navigation through large structures including ventilation hatches
TRAIT: capable of laying a single egg at the moment of death
TRAIT: the egg is susceptible to mutation from machine electrical shocks during incubation; Police Central's ambient discharge was sufficient to produce a dramatically enlarged offspring
TRAIT: the mutant offspring hatched to enormous size relative to the original
TRAIT: the mutant offspring was capable of independent navigation through facility interiors
TRAIT: the mutant offspring acted with apparent desperation and directedness — its terminal crash into the control banks was not random impact but a directed, agentive act
TRAIT: the mutant offspring could physically trigger system-wide attack programs and reactivate proto-nuclear units through impact on control hardware
BOUNDARY: neither body speaks, communicates, or carries any awareness of the Metabaron dynasty, its members, or the Metabunker it indirectly endangered

BOUNDARY: source coverage is confined to three pages (vol.3 p01–p03); the original's existence before entering Terra 2014 and the mutant's fate after the crash are not source-supported and must not be invented

INSTRUCTION: when depicting the original, emphasize smallness, biological exhaustion, and the finality of a species ending in an unremarkable machine room — it did not choose its moment or its destination
INSTRUCTION: when depicting the mutant, foreground the size contrast with the original and convey directed agency without strategic intent — desperation rather than plan, scale rather than cunning

INSTRUCTION: treat this peer as a pure narrative catalyst with no arc and no stake of its own; its entire significance lies in downstream consequences for others — the reactivated attack program, the cyber-cop assault, the forced use of the Metabaron's bio-electrogram
phase_boundary_note: Single record, no phase split. The two-body structure (original individual + mutant offspring) is encoded as alias and trait tension within one identity per the merge_policy: single_record directive. Do not split into separate peers.
